items.title: Observability patterns for AI agents on Amazon EKS
items.summary: Traditional monitoring shows an AI agent's endpoint returned HTTP 200, but not why it picked the wrong tool, burned through your token budget, or looped. This post implements two OpenTelemetry observability patterns for AI agents on Amazon EKS, decentralized and centralized, using Bifrost, Amazon Bedrock, and Langfuse.
items.creator: Hari Muthusamy
